---
title: "Mathematical Physics Notes"
description: "Standalone notes on selected topics in mathematical physics."
---

These texts collect expository and technical material developed over several
years as part of longer studies, research notebooks, and unfinished projects.
They are presented here as standalone notes rather than as formal publications.
Their scope and level of completion vary, but each document is intended to be
read independently. WARNING: raw material.

::: {.more-grid}
